'''Ralf Blobelt Hunt Down With Palpatine''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Ralf Blobelt]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds126.htm Hunt Down With Palpatine], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027092235/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds126.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ralf Blobelt]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down
